questions.stemHtml: A full term baby was born 16 hours ago. As you are the chief paediatrician available, they called you for a regular visit. You assessed the baby and everything were normal, you informed the parents and made a note of it. The doubtful father asks you that the baby hasn’t passed its first motion or urine yet. Is there any abnormalities? What will be reply about the normal time that you should wait for the passing of urine and meconium?
